caption: The drawing depicts two main objects. The upper object is a detailed illustration of a curved panel, possibly the front or back of a sleigh, featuring a black background with intricate decorative patterns in gold, orange, red, and green. The design includes floral motifs, pomegranates, and stylized animal heads, likely eagles, rendered symmetrically on either side. The lower object is a profile view of a single-seat sleigh. The sleigh has a wooden structure with metal runners and reinforcements, primarily colored in shades of green and gold. The main body of the sleigh is painted black and decorated with the same type of gold, orange, and red floral motifs seen on the panel above. The seat has brown padding, and a green blanket or cushion is visible in the footwell. The sleigh also features a tall handle or pole extending from the front and a black stand or column in the center designed to hold the reins or other equipment. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige.
title: Sleigh
